from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u001/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = {(y, x) for y in range(r0, r1+1) for x in range(c0, c1+1)
                      if y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)}
            if cells == border and r1-r0 == c1-c0:
                fill = 7 if (r1-r0+1) % 2 else 2
                for y in range(r0+1, r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-b6d66532.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path, path.exists())
